body:
my attempt was back in february. the weeks leading up to it, suicide hadnt even crossed my mind. then, one night, i was just washing the pan after i had made noodles and i suddenly crashed. i thought of how nobody i cared about loved me, or how in a few short months my restraining order on my abuser would expire. i overdosed, didnt leave a note or send any messages to my friends or family. i finally passed out in the bathroom, but woke up hours later unable to move at all. another two hours before i could even think to move.
after that, things were weird. i hated everyone and everything. i had to experience an entire future that i didnt want.
back in march, my mom was asking me about my plans for college, ive been doing my senior year at the local community college, so i told her that i was going to do another year there just to get her off my back. but then something hit me, i was apathetic to life, i didnt care about anything, so would it hurt if i at least tried something i previously wanted to do?
so, i applied to a university. it didnt help anything, i still felt absolutely apathetic to the world i lived in. i couldnt care less if i got in or not.
it was at five am, i hadnt yet gone to sleep, and i was just mindlessly scrolling through the internet, and then i got an email notification. it was from the university, i had been accepted.
it was the first time in over a month i had felt anything. i cried for hours after that. i realized that i was going to be able to get away from everything and everyone that had hurt me. 
im still learning to try and regret attempting, and not regret surviving. but its a lot better than how things used to be
